title: The for Loop
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of the for loop using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates the for loop.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **The for Loop** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. Choose a loop form based on when the condition is checked and what is iterated; ranges and collection iteration make bounds and state changes explicit. Use the subtopics—Iterating Over Ranges, Iterating Over Collections, Indexed Iteration—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.

items.text: Iterating Over Collections is best learned by tracing a small collection before and after the operation. Check ordering, duplicate handling, empty inputs, and whether the API returns a new value or mutates a mutable receiver.
